about: Event listing pages read weekly by scripts/scan-listings.mjs (schema.org Event data, else event links with a date next to them). Events we don't have go to data/event-pipeline.json -> candidates. filter: true keeps only names that look biotech/pharma/health (for general venue calendars). A source that keeps reading 0 events in listingScanReport should be replaced. 10times, Conference Index, Eventbrite and clocate block automated reads (403/405), so the monthly gap check covers them by hand. Tried and removed on 2026-11-06 (404, blocked or unreadable): Messe München calendar, Messe Frankfurt calendar, Messe Düsseldorf calendar, RAI Amsterdam calendar, Bella Center Copenhagen calendar, Paris Expo calendar, Boston Convention Center calendar, San Diego Convention Center calendar, Oxford Global events, Hanson Wade events, SelectBio conferences, SMi Group pharma, SMi Group defence, Informa life sciences events, Keystone Symposia meetings, EMBL events; these organisers are covered by the monthly organiser check instead.
